result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. The module compiles, but I didn't run any tests and didn't add a test for this.

In `getAllTeams()` in `LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, I added a condition to the remainder branch. An unmatched contributor is added to "Undefined Team" only if their latest-commit date is blank or `Contributor.isActive()` is true. Unmatched dormant contributors are now left out entirely.

Configured teams are unchanged, so they keep all their members. I didn't read `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` (its source isn't in the repo), so I handle the blank case explicitly instead of relying on it.

I did not touch `LandscapeReportPeopleTopologyTab.java`, which also mentions "Undefined Team".
